final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS group_average FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS value FROM group_averages), differences AS (SELECT g.ID, g.SEX, g.group_average, g.group_average - o.value AS difference FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(difference) AS value FROM differences GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.group_average, d.difference, d.difference - s.value AS difference_from_sex_average FROM differences AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.difference > s.value ORDER BY difference_from_sex_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
